name: Escoffier
notes: A Cryo freeze sub-DPS who heals with her Burst (172% ATK + 1,078 at level 1) and after it. Both sources put the Skill before the Burst and agree on 4pc Golden Troupe, ATK% or ER Sands, a Cryo DMG or ATK% Goblet, a crit Circlet and Symphonist of Scents and Staff of Homa first. Goals are Game8's (ATK 2,000 or above, CR 60-70%, CD 120% or above, ER 160-180% or above, lower with more Cryo units); ER 160% is its low end and falls in KQM's Double Cryo range at C0 (130-165%). No DMG goal is set, since the Goblet may be ATK%. Blizzard Strayer is KQM's second set, Noblesse Oblige Game8's; Favonius Lance is on both lists.
